Partly built

Find a rental

Your assistant will search listings, call landlords with your consent and bring you viewings to decide.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. GoalYou no tool neededSay what you need: area, budget band, dates.
  2. PlanYour assistant via browser operatorSearches the listings and hands over to you for anything it should not do alone.
  3. PlanYour assistant via consented callCalls landlords, says it is an assistant, and only with your consent.
  4. ProposalYou no tool neededEach viewing arrives as a proposal; you decide.
What you get
Starts withA person looking for a home
StatusPartly built
The listings checked, the calls made, the viewings you accepted.

What it keeps to

  • A call is made only with your consent and is disclosed.
  • The browser hands over for a code, a captcha, a payment or a signature.
  • Demand is shown only as counts, never as names.
